items.title: Descent of a family of relative cycles to a Noetherian model, criterion via completely decomposed proper morphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 22 行陈述（72 行证明）、相对循环族下降到 Noetherian 模型的判据：正向具名 get-cycles 加基变换；反向 approximation 写极限 + 六条 Limits 引理 + more-morphisms 下降 + 等点闭集 + 构造性极限提升 + 具名唯一下降 + h 下降验 z 成员。14 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-relative-r-cycle-general (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3154-3175

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Direction (1) to (2) descends the Noetherian witness by the named get-cycles lemma and base change; direction (2) to (1) approximates S as a limit of finite type schemes, descends the completely decomposed proper morphism and the flat closed subschemes through six named Limits lemmas and one More on Morphisms lemma, forces the two pullbacks to agree on the fibre product via the closedness of the equal locus and a constructible-limit argument, then descends the family uniquely through the completely decomposed cover and checks it lands in the relative cycles group (source lines 3177-3248)
